title: The Creator Machine and Hydration+ Sticks
lessons: The player first recognizes PRIME from the creator machine around Logan Paul and KSI, not from a nutrition label, and spots the machine's loudest move on the gym TV: PRIME's logo dead center of the WrestleMania mat and both corners of the UFC Octagon rebranded into recovery zones.
The player already buys PRIME and has started keeping powdered Hydration+ sticks in a gym bag instead of carrying bottles.

text: Late gym. You know the two names on the bottle, Logan Paul and KSI, from a decade of videos. You couldn't say what's in the bottle.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I knew those creators, Logan and KSI, before I knew what was even in you.

entry-first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: That was the launch. That was the whole launch. Worked, didn't it?

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're admitting the hype got here before I knew what you sold.

entry-first-4.speaker: PRIME
text: I was built in public. Creator drops, sellouts, noise, repeat. You met the show first. Everybody did.

On the gym TV, a highlight reel loops: PRIME's logo dead center of the WrestleMania mat, the first brand ever allowed there, and both corners of the UFC Octagon renamed "PRIME Hydration Recovery Zones."

entry-first-reel-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You bought the middle of the ring and called it hydration.

entry-first-reel-2.speaker: PRIME
text: First brand ever on that mat. Both corners of the Octagon. Look at it. Look at it!

entry-first-reel-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: It's still a drink standing in a spotlight.

entry-first-reel-4.speaker: PRIME
text: The spotlight's the point. Logan and KSI got me in front of you before any label could. The mat's just the biggest thing I could put my name on next.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: Reel's about to loop again. Say what you're going to say.

choices.text: It worked. I knew exactly what PRIME was before I ever tried it.
So the hype outran the product.
I don't want a personality cult attached to my sports drink.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: And now you're actually talking to me. Scoreboard.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Guilty. Separate my founders from my formula. They're not the same review.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're weirdly okay admitting that.

first-2-2.speaker: PRIME
text: I'm confident enough to survive a nutrition label.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then I'm probably exhausting. I've never once advertised a low-volume setting. Don't think I have one.
Gym bag. Where the bottle used to roll around, there's a row of Hydration+ powder sticks.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: The bottle turned into a little powder packet.

entry-return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Powder. Dump it in water. Same thing you already buy, minus the bottle taking up half your bag.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: Well? Bag's lighter, isn't it?

choices.text: This is a lot easier to keep in my bag.
I'm still paying bottle money for flavored powder.
If I already have water, I can just drink water.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Right. I didn't get better. I got easier to carry. Sometimes that's all it takes to stay.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Yeah. It got smaller. It didn't get cheaper. I'm not going to act like the packet's a discount.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: You can. I'm for the nights when plain water isn't what you actually want. Those nights exist. I've built a lot on them.
